entries.title: Sign in to your own Bitbucket Data Center server
entries.body: The Bitbucket form in Settings → Integrations now takes the address of your own Bitbucket Data Center server, version 8.19 or newer, with an HTTP access token you make on it; the form names the permissions it needs. Add project lists the repositories you can read there, and a crewmate's work is offered as a pull request. Your click merges it only at the version you approved: if someone pushes in the meantime, nothing is merged and the task says so. Batched pull requests, forks and your crew's own reach to the server come later.

picture.alt: Settings → Integrations with the Bitbucket form open for bitbucket.example.com: the token's Project read and Repository write permissions, the address, a Make a key on bitbucket.example.com button and a filled key field.
